name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport started unconventionally. After serving in the Russian military as a vehicle mechanic, he discovered a knack for working with composite materials while repairing helicopter rotor blades. He transitioned this skillset into the automotive industry, initially working on structural components for luxury vehicles before his passion for speed drew him to motorsport.

His meticulous approach to composite work, coupled with his military-honed discipline, makes him a reliable asset. While not one for the spotlight, Dimitri takes immense pride in the structural integrity and aerodynamic efficiency of the components he crafts. He believes in function over form, prioritising durability and performance above all else, a principle that has occasionally clashed with designers aiming for aesthetic perfection.

At 23XI Racing, Dimitri blends his deep technical knowledge with a willingness to adapt. He is known for his ability to diagnose and repair even the most complex composite failures under pressure. He’s a stickler for detail, ensuring every piece he touches meets the highest standards.

physical.description: A stocky man with a weathered face, bearing the marks of years spent dedicated to demanding work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needle point before starting work.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black tea throughout the day.
Refuses to listen to music while working, claiming it distracts him from the intricacies of the composite structure.
